body.name: totalized positive-part endpoint construction
body.construction: Estimate the observable covariance, apply the common ridge map \(R_n\) to compute \(\widehat\alpha_n\), \(\widehat\beta_n\), and \(\widehat\delta_n\), and report \(\widehat\Theta_n^{\mathrm{tot}}\); a negative empirical slack is mapped to the singleton \(\{\widehat{\check\theta}_n\}\). The construction is defined even when \(\widehat\Sigma_{zz,n}\) is singular.
